bio_strategy_hydrophobic: Strongly hydrophobic transmembrane / membrane-associated protein. For small-molecule targeting, lipid-based nanoparticles (LNPs) or lipophilic prodrug technology is required. Recommended alternative: Therapeutic Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC).
bio_strategy_amphipathic: Amphipathic protein character, potentially flexible surface loops or a partially exposed core. Well-suited for allosteric modulator or protein-protein interaction (PPI) inhibitor design.
bio_strategy_hydrophilic: Highly hydrophilic, well-soluble cytoplasmic or extracellular protein. Ideal target for classical Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD). Formulates well in conventional aqueous formulations.
bio_charge_acidic: Acidic isoelectric point ({pi}). Carries a net negative charge at physiological pH (7.4). For targeting receptor pockets, integration of positive partial charge groups (basic groups, e.g. amines, piperidines) is recommended.
bio_charge_neutral: Neutral / Physiological isoelectric point ({pi}). Minimal net electrostatic barrier. Binding affinity can be maximized primarily by optimizing specific hydrogen bonds and directed Van der Waals / pi-pi interactions.
bio_charge_basic: Basic isoelectric point ({pi}). Carries a net positive charge at physiological pH. Incorporation of negative-character, acidic, or bioisostere functional groups (e.g. carboxyl, tetrazole, sulfonamide) can dramatically increase specificity.
bio_stability_stable: The target protein shows a STABLE kinetic profile in vitro (Index: {index}). This greatly facilitates recombinant expression, laboratory crystallization, and High-Throughput Screening (HTS) assay execution.
bio_stability_unstable: The protein is structurally UNSTABLE / conformationally flexible in aqueous solution (Index: {index}). May undergo rapid proteolytic degradation in living systems. Design recommendation: conformational stabilizing chaperones or PROTAC (proteolysis-targeting chimera) technology.

landing_hero_subtitle: Enterprise bioinformatics platform for quantitative protein analysis, 3D visualization, mutation simulation, and intelligent comparison.
landing_professional_toolkit: A professional toolkit for researchers, biotech companies, and academic laboratories.
landing_feature_quant_desc: Automatic calculation of 12+ biophysical parameters: molecular weight, pI, GRAVY, aromaticity, instability index, extinction coefficient, and secondary structure fractions.
landing_feature_3d_desc: Interactive 3D protein viewing via Mol* viewer using PDB codes. Supports 3D snapshot capture.
landing_feature_mutation_desc: Real-time analysis of site-specific mutations. Compare all parameters between wild-type and mutant proteins with directional change indicators.
landing_feature_comparison_desc: Side-by-side comparison of previous analyses in tabular format, with colored bar charts and automatic difference (Δ) calculation.
landing_feature_export_desc: Generate professional PDF reports and CSV data sheets with one click. PDF uses DejaVu fonts for precise typography.
landing_feature_notebook_desc: Attach notes to every analysis. Automatic versioning ensures experiment reproducibility.
landing_how_it_works_subtitle: Three simple steps from sequence to complete biophysical profile.
landing_step1_desc: Paste your protein amino acid sequence, or provide a PDB code for 3D viewing.
landing_step2_desc: The PRISM engine computes all biophysical parameters using BioPython.
landing_step3_desc: View results on interactive charts, compare, export, and make informed decisions.
